goal: Connect the GUI to an existing node process over IPC instead of spawning a new child process
Let users start and stop the GUI independently of a long-running background node
agreement: Unaddressed objection: GUI crashes on sendButtonClicked when using external signers or PSBTs (Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: node crashes when GUI connects without -disablewallet to a wallet-free node (jimhashhq)
Concept approval for the -ipcconnect option name and functionality (laanwj)
Verified basic IPC connectivity works in manual testing (Sjors)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it lets GUI instances attach to and detach from an independent node process
Advances process separation for multiprocess builds
